owner_notes: W-05 is done. FTG's measurements were re-run, using the design's exact definitions, on the two FTG towns already on disk. Nothing touched a website and nothing went into plat/.

Five FTG reference numbers in the design change when measured exactly. Tree spacing goes from 9.7 to 10.6 m: the old script skipped isolated trees. Ungated wall crossings go from 6 and 2 to 3 and 1: the old count included the wall's ends. The water outline step of 50 m holds for one town only; the other's coast is drawn at 15 m. Outline anisotropy goes from 0.20-0.33 to 0.33-0.37. FTG's 15-degree turn limit has one exception in the second town. A Fable seat should rule on the section 13.5 wording (E05 section 8).
The design names a 'signature vector' for between-seed variety but never defines its parts. W-05 proposed a definition (E05 section 6). W-09 (MFCG) must use the same one, so it needs a ruling.
FTG's per-size rows and its variety floor are computed when the six daily captures are in (day 1 is done). No new code is needed.
